column1: List of reported tornadoes - Monday, March 19, 2012
column4: A camper was flipped, a cinder block fence was overturned, and a barn and trailer were destroyed. One house suffered significant roof damage and several power poles were damaged. Three people were injured.
column5: Preliminary survey. A semi trailer was overturned.
column6: Preliminary survey. Power lines were knocked down.
column7: Preliminary survey. Damage reported to six homes. Two people were injured.
column9: A large machine shed was destroyed.
column11: Second-earliest tornado on record in Minnesota history (earliest was on March 18, 1968). Numerous trees and several structures were damaged along the tornado's path.
column13: Brief tornado over open country with no damage.
column15: The roof of a mobile home was damaged, and numerous trees were snapped or uprooted.
column16: Two homes and a Walmart were damaged and a few trees and tree limbs were snapped.
